sentences.la: Mīlitēs cēnent, dummodo nē clāment.
sentences.en: Let the soldiers dine, provided they do not shout.

sentences.la: Fīlia quiēscere potest, dummodo epistulās legat.
sentences.en: The daughter may rest, provided she reads the letters.

sentences.la: Syra cēnābit, dummodo nē pater veniat.
sentences.en: Syra will dine, as long as the father does not come.

sentences.la: Syra labōret, dummodo mel habeat.
sentences.en: Let Syra work, provided she has honey.

sentences.la: Mīlitēs laetī sunt, dummodo equōs habeant.
sentences.en: The soldiers are happy, provided they have the horses.

sentences.la: Syra dormīre potest, dummodo Iūlius absit.
sentences.en: Syra can sleep, provided Julius is away.

sentences.la: Puerī lūdant, dummodo nē clāment.
sentences.en: Let the boys play, provided they do not shout.

sentences.la: Dāvus cēnāre potest, dummodo epistulam scrībat.
sentences.en: Davus may dine, provided he writes the letter.

sentences.la: Lucernam tibi dabō, dummodo eam teneās.
sentences.en: I will give you an oil lamp, provided you hold it.

sentences.la: Ex vīllā curram, dummodo nē imber cadat.
sentences.en: I will run out of the country house, as long as no rain falls.

sentences.la: Syra cantābit, dummodo nē Iūlius audiat.
sentences.en: Syra will sing, as long as Julius does not hear.

sentences.la: Dāvus labōret, dummodo frūmentum accipiat.
sentences.en: Let Davus work, provided he receives grain.

sentences.la: Puella laeta est, dummodo aquam bibat.
sentences.en: The girl is happy, provided she drinks water.

sentences.la: Mēdus dormīre potest, dummodo medicus adsit.
sentences.en: Medus can sleep, provided the doctor is present.

sentences.la: Discipulī dormiant, dummodo nē cantent.
sentences.en: Let the pupils sleep, provided they do not sing.

sentences.la: Dēlia cēnāre potest, dummodo epistulās legat.
sentences.en: Delia may dine, provided she reads the letters.

sentences.la: Gemmam tibi vēndam, dummodo eam sūmās.
sentences.en: I will sell you a jewel, provided you take it.

sentences.la: Iūlia labōrābit, dummodo nē Aemilia audiat.
sentences.en: Julia will work, as long as Aemilia does not hear.

sentences.la: Dēlia maneat, dummodo mel accipiat.
sentences.en: Let Delia stay, provided she receives honey.

sentences.la: Syra discere potest, dummodo pater absit.
sentences.en: Syra can learn, provided the father is away.

sentences.la: Puellae dormiant, dummodo nē rīdeant.
sentences.en: Let the girls sleep, provided they do not laugh.

sentences.la: Discipulus ambulāre potest, dummodo epistulās scrībat.
sentences.en: The pupil may walk, provided he writes the letters.

sentences.la: Cibum tibi vēndam, dummodo eum sūmās.
sentences.en: I will sell you food, provided you take it.

sentences.la: Ex silvā ībō, dummodo nē imber cadat.
sentences.en: I will go out of the wood, as long as no rain falls.

sentences.la: Puella manēbit, dummodo nē Cornēlius clāmet.
sentences.en: The girl will stay, as long as Cornelius does not shout.
